findings.finding: Dynamic audio detection treated playback advancement as audible autoplay without proving audibility.
findings.resolution: Partially addressed. Generated positive fixtures now mark only the harness-generated non-silent WAV tone as known non-silent. Arbitrary saved-site media no longer receives the audible-autoplay evidence token from playback advancement alone.

findings.finding: The probe did not observe audio continuing for more than 3 seconds.
findings.resolution: Addressed for the generated fixture lane. The dynamic probe and validator now sample for 3300ms and require currentTime advancement across that window plus a loop/duration basis over three seconds.

findings.finding: Script-started or Web Audio autoplay is a false-negative gap because detection requires autoplay media elements.
findings.resolution: Not addressed in this slice. Remains future work: instrument HTMLMediaElement.play and AudioContext starts before page load.

findings.finding: External/custom audio controls are not exercised, so no-independent-control can be overclaimed.
findings.resolution: Partially addressed. The probe now searches for plausible native/custom independent controls and refuses no-independent-control when a plausible control is present. It does not yet exercise custom controls.

findings.finding: Static markup-only lanes still emit audio-control findings that can be mistaken for audible autoplay evidence.
findings.resolution: Partially addressed by packet discipline. Static findings remain applicability/review surfaces without the required dynamic evidence claims; naming cleanup remains future work.

findings.finding: Generated validation rows collapsed dynamic audio evidence to hits, then prompt-pack builders synthesized required claims from expected labels.
findings.resolution: Addressed for audio-control. The validator now persists measured audio candidate fields and evidenceClaims; prompt-pack builders prefer row-level measured evidence claims and include measuredEvidence in packet detail.

findings.finding: Visual prompt packs omitted audio-control SC and required evidence.
findings.resolution: Addressed. The vision prompt pack now includes SC 1.4.2 and required evidence for audio-control while preserving screenshot-only uncertainty.

findings.finding: Audio visual evidence was marked as visualAgreement=true even though screenshots cannot prove audio playback.
findings.resolution: Addressed. Audio-control visual checks are now contextual, not positive visual agreement evidence.
